courses.summary: 以公開光子研發與封裝機構為地理代表，討論Ge 吸收、載子收集與光電量測基準如何由單一元件走向可量測、可封裝的系統。地圖沿用本學院矽光子課程的代表據點，並非此技術唯一發源地或所有文獻實驗位置。
courses.summaryEn: A public photonic research/packaging institution provides geographic context for translating Ge absorption, carrier collection and optoelectronic reference planes from a component into a measurable packaged system. The map uses the academy’s silicon-photonics reference location, not the sole invention site or every cited laboratory.

history.title: 從元件演示到可重現介面
history.titleEn: From component demonstration to reproducible interfaces
history.text: 公開研究與模擬教學逐步把Ge 吸收、載子收集與光電量測基準連到基準、容差與封裝驗證。本課沿此方法脈絡安排作業，不宣稱單一機構獨創整項技術。
history.textEn: Public research and simulation tutorials connect Ge absorption, carrier collection and optoelectronic reference planes to reference conditions, tolerances and package validation. The course follows that methodological progression without assigning invention to one institution.

history.title: 跨元件與封裝的共同驗證
history.text: 相同光學性能需在固定、溫變與電性連接之後重新檢查；原始研究結果與量產資格是不同證據層級。
history.textEn: Recheck optical behavior after attachment, temperature change and electrical connection; research results and production qualification are different evidence levels.
